title: Diagnose, Then Refine: A Closed-Loop TTS System with AudioLLM-Guided Correction
abstract: arXiv:2608.28970v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current TTS systems typically rely on open-loop, single-pass generation and can produce sporadic local prosodic defects, such as misplaced stress, unnatural pauses, or flattened intonation, that utterance-level metrics often fail to expose. We present LoopTTS, a judge-guided Filter-Judge-Refiner framework for recovering low-quality TTS outputs diagnosed by an AudioLLM. Given an initial utterance from a base TTS model, an AudioLLM Judge identifies salient prosodic issues and generates structured refine instructions; a Refiner, our fine-grained instruction-following TTS model, then performs guided expressive re-synthesis conditioned on the initial utterance, target text, and instruction. To train the Refiner, we construct Refiner-DB, a 42K-example AudioLLM-annotated dataset with word-level prosodic weak supervision. Human evaluation on diagnosed low-quality utterances shows that LoopTTS can detect perceptually salient errors and correct

translated_title: 诊断，然后精修：一种基于AudioLLM引导校正的闭环TTS系统
translated_abstract: 当前的文本转语音（TTS）系统通常依赖于开环、单次生成，可能产生零星的局部韵律缺陷，例如重音错位、不自然的停顿或语调平淡，而语句级指标往往无法暴露这些问题。我们提出了LoopTTS，这是一个由评判器引导的“过滤-评判-精修”框架，用于修复由AudioLLM诊断出的低质量TTS输出。给定来自基础TTS模型的初始语音，AudioLLM评判器会识别显著的韵律问题并生成结构化的精修指令；随后，精修器——我们的细粒度指令遵循TTS模型——基于初始语音、目标文本和指令执行引导性的表现力重合成。为训练精修器，我们构建了Refiner-DB，一个包含42K样本、由AudioLLM标注并带有词级韵律弱监督的数据集。对诊断出的低质量语音的人工评估表明，LoopTTS能够检测出感知上显著的错误并加以纠正。
tldr: LoopTTS提出了一种由AudioLLM评判器引导的闭环“过滤-评判-精修”框架，通过诊断TTS输出中的局部韵律缺陷并生成结构化精修指令，由细粒度指令遵循的精修模型进行引导性重合成，从而自动修复低质量TTS输出。
en_tdlr: LoopTTS introduces a closed-loop Filter-Judge-Refiner framework where an AudioLLM judge diagnoses local prosodic defects in TTS outputs and generates structured instructions, enabling a fine-grained instruction-following refiner to perform guided re-synthesis and automatically correct low-quality TTS outputs.
